Latest
data.value: SELECT payload::text FROM company_bank_profiles WHERE company_id=@company AND known_ticks<=@ticks ORDER BY known_ticks DESC LIMIT 1

data.name: Versions
data.value: SELECT sequence AS "Sequence",payload::text AS "Payload" FROM company_bank_profiles WHERE sequence>@after ORDER BY sequence LIMIT @limit

data.name: FindHash
data.value: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT content_hash FROM company_bank_profiles WHERE company_id=@company AND revision_id=@revision),'')

data.name: LatestRevision
data.value: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT revision_id FROM company_bank_profiles WHERE company_id=@company ORDER BY known_ticks DESC LIMIT 1),'')

data.name: Insert
data.value: INSERT INTO company_bank_profiles(company_id,revision_id,known_ticks,content_hash,bank_data,payload) VALUES(@company,@revision,@ticks,@hash,CAST(@data AS JSONB),CAST(@payload AS JSONB))
